system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: msp_schedule_mandi_visit and msp_check_quality_status.. my visit_date is dummy_visit_date_4699, my procurement_token is dummy_procurement_token_8199.

function.name: msp_schedule_mandi_visit
function.description: Schedules a specific date/time for mandi visit. Token must be generated. Requires session_token. Does NOT deliver produce. Fails if no token exists or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: msp_check_quality_status
function.description: Checks quality inspection results. Returns quality_grade ('FAQ' or 'below_FAQ'). Produce must meet Fair Average Quality standards. Substandard produce is rejected. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify results. Fails if produce not delivered.
